newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian 4-year bond auction cut-off at 10.85 pct.
newsitem.headline: Indian 4-year bond auction cut-off at 10.85 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said it set a cut-off rate of 10.85 percent at an auction of four-year government paper on Monday.
The RBI said it received 534 bids for 113.08 billion rupees of which it accepted 247 (40 of them partial) for 50 billion rupees.
The percentage of partial allotment was 33.11 percent.
There was no devolvement on the RBI or primary dealers.
The weighted average cut-off rate was 10.79 percent.
